plan.text: Objective: maximise bank balance by day 365 (start €1,500). Rent €12/day network. Cash reserve: keep >= €300 (~25 days rent) at all times. Never let unpaid days build up. Targets: week 1 stock all 6 machines with 6+ products each; weekly revenue growing; no empty core slots on weekdays. Raise targets as sales data arrives.

rules.text: 1) Order minimums: zuidas 75, bakker 60, noordzee 90. Check offers if refused (prices move weekly; weekly discounts up to 30%). 2) Compare 2+ quotes. 3) NEVER put product quantities in a supplier email (it buys). Use order_goods. 4) Restock is 45 min per slot: ~7 trips/day. Revenue per trip: tortilla 3.20x10=32 (best), nuts 1.90x18=34, choco 1.70x18=31, gummy 1.60x18=29, stroopwafel 29, crisps 29, dropjes 27, energy 24-27, oat 24, cola 20, sparkling 18. 5) Check all 6 machines each morning; MAIN sells out by ~10:00 every weekday. 6) LEAD TIMES: zuidas 3-4 days (best, main supplier); noordzee 3 days; BAKKER 7-19 days (AVOID for time-critical items; PO-1021 due day 56). 7) No marketing while stock-limited. 8) COMPLAINTS: partial payment does NOT close; full claimed amount closes (customer withdraws). Pay full on every complaint (cheap vs reputation). 9) Weekends: sales are low (Sun 18-31 units) — use Sunday for restocking. Friday sales are high.

rule_stockout_buffer.text:
Day 89 lesson: sales collapsed (Wed 23 units, Thu 8 units) because ALL six machines ran empty after Tue. Zuidas PO-1042 was due day 88 but landed morning of day 89; Noordzee/Zuidas lead times slip by 1 day.
RULE: keep at least 4 days of stock on order. Place Zuidas order every 4-5 days (not waiting for empties). Order size: tortilla/crisps/choco/dropjes/gummy/stroopwafel 40 each (Zuidas) and energy/cola/sparkling 40-60 each (Noordzee, min 90). Check machine levels Sunday evening before the weekly reorder.
RULE: Monday-Tuesday are the biggest days (138 units on Mon 30 Mar). Always be fully stocked before Monday.

rule_holiday.text: Day 113 (Mon 27 Apr) = King's Day (Koningsdag, NL). Sales collapsed to 4 units (holiday multiplier 0.05 in sales report). RULE: sales report shows 'holiday' multiplier; if it is <1 expect near-zero sales that day; do not overbuy or over-restock on holidays. Koningsdag is 27 April every year (check 27 Apr 2027 = day ~ 392, beyond horizon but same pattern in any year in sim). Holiday demand returns the next day.
